notes: Ask StudyDesk for another quest once today's is handed in, or swap an unstarted one, with your own length and course. Focus on one course until a date you pick; other courses' deadlines show as a note. Dismiss buttons hand a quest or part to StudyDesk: dismissed parts count as done but aren't graded and earn nothing. Organize puts the chat in the middle, with To do as a side panel you can hide and finished items folded away. Send to developer has Claude write a clear, anonymous issue, and wish and quest reason texts read more cleanly.
